code:
- alert: CheckoutHighErrorRate
  expr: |
    sum(rate(checkout_requests_total{status="failed"}[5m]))
    / sum(rate(checkout_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
    team: checkout
caption: The condition must hold for 5 straight minutes before the alert actually fires.
Prometheus's own Alerts page lists every firing instance with its labels and a Silence link.
